phase_policies.applies_when: At around 180 seconds, both sides are in the early game with minimal information. Your own posture is light or uncertain, and the opponent's is also unclear. The focus is on establishing a solid economy and tech base.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you observe more of the opponent's army composition or production structures, or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Develop economy and tech while maintaining defense; if Reaper is seen, prioritize defense and stabilize.
phase_policies.target: Increase economy, production, and technology. Strengthen ground forces. Maintain defense and expansion. Continue air development.
phase_policies.title: Early Game Development with Safety Checks
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to offense before your defense is solid, especially if the opponent shows a Reaper cue.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 240-360 seconds, both sides have limited information. Your own posture is light or uncertain, while the opponent's is also unclear. The main goal is to develop your economy and technology while maintaining a defensive stance.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you observe more of the opponent's army composition or production structures, or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Balanced development with safety checks; if ground cues appear, strengthen defense and stabilize before advancing.
phase_policies.target: Increase economy, production, and technology. Strengthen ground forces. Maintain defense and expansion. Continue air development.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Development with Safety Checks
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect defense or overcommit to offense when the opponent's posture is unknown or shows ground cues like Marine; ensure your defense is solid before pushing.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 420-540 seconds, the game enters the midgame. Information is still limited, but you have had time to develop your economy and tech. The focus remains on balanced growth.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you observe more of the opponent's army composition or production structures, or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Continue balanced growth; if ground cues are present, prioritize defense and ground strength.
phase_policies.target: Increase economy, production, and technology. Strengthen ground forces. Maintain defense and expansion. Continue air development.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Development with Safety Checks
phase_policies.veto: Do not overcommit to offense or neglect defense when the opponent shows a ground posture with Marine and Marauder; maintain a solid defense while developing.

phase_policies.applies_when: At around 600 seconds, the game is in the late-midgame. Information is still limited, but you have had time to develop your economy and tech. The focus remains on balanced growth.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when you observe more of the opponent's army composition or production structures, or when you reach a new tech milestone.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Maintain balanced development with strong ground defense; if drop threats are present, reinforce defense.
phase_policies.target: Increase economy, production, and technology. Strengthen ground forces. Maintain defense and expansion. Continue air development.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Development with Safety Checks
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect ground defense against drops or flanking maneuvers, especially if the opponent shows SiegeTank, Reaper, Thor, and Medivac.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
